about: WOOF-NAM domains: woof-nam run --domain <name>. Each row names a configfile in this folder and how its static surface is made. A new domain is a configfile and a row here, never new code (namgpu/domains.py reads this table).

conus12.title: NAM 12 km CONUS parent (954 x 835 x 60)

conus4.title: 4 km CONUS (1371 x 1101 x 60, no parameterized convection)

conus5.title: 5 km CONUS (1097 x 881 x 60, no parameterized convection)

static_kinds.nam-analysis: terrain, land, soil and vegetation from an archived NAM native analysis: the case own bgrd3d00 when it has one, else static/nam12_static.npz, else built once from the archived analysis of the same month and day (latest archived year)
static_kinds.geog: built on the GPU from WPS_GEOG (NAMGPU_GEOG, WPS_GEOG or ~/WPS_GEOG) by init-static-build with the permissive soil set (SoilGrids texture, ERA5 deep-soil temperature; NAMGPU_GEOG_SOIL=wrf opts into the held WPS STATSGO/FAO set); rebuilt when the start month or the soil set changes (greenness and albedo are monthly)
